sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: But... I did the right thing.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly trying to steady herself with a small, fragile sense of reassurance and pride, even though she still feels anxious about being late and judged.

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels anxious and embarrassed about being late, but quietly steels herself with a small, reluctant resolve because she knows helping the girl was the right choice.

gpt.rationale: The sequence tracks the scene’s anxiety-to-relief arc well, but repeated overt fear and upbeat happiness are somewhat stronger and more externalized than this introverted, subtly expressive character would usually show.

claude.rationale: Sprites consistently reflect introversion through subtle emotion and restraint (quiet happiness, downcast sadness, fear held inward), with only minor misalignment: the initial 'fear' for being late fits her reserved anxiety, but 'happiness' when comforting the girl slightly overplays her outward expression for someone who internalizes emotion—a reserved character would show this more subtly, perhaps through neutral-to-slight-smile rather than full happiness.
